title: Story premise ENT050: The Marble Museum Tour
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (block-world chain reactions). Hook: One marble. Every exhibit gets a moment. Takeaway/theme: A route can change its configuration as a traveler advances.
description: A block curator needs one glowing marble to illuminate a series of exhibits, but the last room is unreachable by the original track. Each arriving marble activates a turntable that aligns the next track segment, and the final turntable routes it back through the ceiling as the museum’s glowing exit sign.
